verdict.rationale: Paychex Flex documents W-2 access through its 24/7 online portal and says it simplifies 1099 reporting for contractors, with automatic tax filing. That points to year-end form handling, but the evidence never explicitly says W-2s and 1099s are generated and distributed automatically at year-end. Missing for 10: explicit automatic year-end W-2/1099 generation, documented distribution of forms to workers (electronic or mail), 1099 delivery to contractors, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can have W-2s and 1099s generated and distributed to workers automatically at year-end
